card.name: Set cardinality sentences and Rhabdomyolysis
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after 'the cardinality of the naturals/reals/integers' in set-theory text. Also the 'd' inside 'Rhabdomyolysis' in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Cardinality in set theory
modes.description: Linking words such as 'is', 'as' and 'the' after a statement about the cardinality of number sets.
modes.example: The cardinality of the natural numbers is known<< as>> aleph-null.

modes.label: Rhabdomyolysis spelling
modes.description: The letter 'd' partway through the word rhabdomyolysis in warnings.

card.writes: Suggests math terms starting with 'geom' or 'geometry' and discourages 'infinite' and 'definition' words.
card.plain: It fires on wording about the size of infinite sets, and on the middle of the word rhabdomyolysis.
